title: a derivative block with a populated `residuals` list is rejected, naming the rule that would require a schema bump
why: Derivative artifacts re-read their own primal inputs, so `residual_policy`
is always `recompute` and `residuals` is always empty. A populated list
would need a new schema version to define what it means, so accepting it
silently would run a derivative kernel under metadata this host cannot
The shared validator has rejected this all along, but the host loader used
to check only the ABI tag and scalar type, so this exact sidecar could load
with zero diagnostics through that door. This fixture checks that the host
loader now rejects it too, before anything is loaded, in both languages.
